# Wiki Index — Where to Look

This page is the map of the knowledge base. Pick a **family** below, then open
the folder's `index.md` for its full listing. The sidebar (Docs tab) mirrors
the folder structure; Search and the Graph tab work across everything.

## 1. Foundations & Concepts
- [[wiki/concepts/00-index|concepts/]] — cross-cutting ideas, reasoning, and research
- [[wiki/entities/00-index|entities/]] — auto-extracted entity notes

## 2. Frontend & UI
- [[wiki/frontend/00-index|frontend/]] — HTML/CSS/JS, frameworks, styling, UI patterns
- [[wiki/frontend-frameworks/00-index|frontend-frameworks/]] — framework entity notes
- [[wiki/js-ts-ecosystem/00-index|js-ts-ecosystem/]] — JavaScript/TypeScript tooling
- [[wiki/web-platforms/00-index|web-platforms/]] — browser & web platform concepts

## 3. Backend & APIs
- [[wiki/api-services/00-index|api-services/]] — REST/HTTP services, API clients, JSON
- [[wiki/api-protocols/00-index|api-protocols/]] — HTTP methods, status codes, protocol design
- [[wiki/cloud-infra/00-index|cloud-infra/]] — cloud hosting & infrastructure services

## 4. Security & Identity
- [[wiki/security-auth/00-index|security-auth/]] — authentication, authorization, web security
- [[wiki/security/00-index|security/]] — general security concepts
- [[wiki/identity/00-index|identity/]] — identity, sessions, MFA, password policy

## 5. Data & Storage
- [[wiki/data-storage/00-index|data-storage/]] — databases, storage engines, caching, streaming

## 6. Infrastructure & DevOps
- [[wiki/infrastructure/00-index|infrastructure/]] — containers, networking, service mesh
- [[wiki/devops-infra/00-index|devops-infra/]] — CI/CD, deployment, SRE
- [[wiki/development/00-index|development/]] — dev workflows, CLI tools, ORMs
- [[wiki/dev-tools/00-index|dev-tools/]] — developer tooling entities
- [[wiki/tooling/00-index|tooling/]] — shell/CLI tooling entities
- [[wiki/software-engineering/00-index|software-engineering/]] — engineering practice, testing culture

## 7. Shell & OS
- [[wiki/os-shell/00-index|os-shell/]] — shell scripting, POSIX, text processing
- [[wiki/shell-environment/00-index|shell-environment/]] — shell environment entities

## 8. AI / ML / Agents
- [[wiki/ai-ml/00-index|ai-ml/]] — machine learning concepts and models
- [[wiki/ml-frameworks/00-index|ml-frameworks/]] — ML frameworks
- [[wiki/llm-agents/00-index|llm-agents/]] — LLM agent patterns
- [[wiki/agent-systems/00-index|agent-systems/]] — agent architecture (loops, delegation, memory)
- [[wiki/prompt-engineering/00-index|prompt-engineering/]] — prompt patterns and techniques

## 9. Cognition, Learning & Meta
- [[wiki/meta-learning/00-index|meta-learning/]] — metacognition, self-regulated learning, expertise
- [[wiki/memory/00-index|memory/]] — memory techniques, PKM, note-taking
- [[wiki/episodes/00-index|episodes/]] — learning from events, after-action reviews
- [[wiki/questions/00-index|questions/]] — question design, inquiry, epistemic practice
- [[wiki/reflections/00-index|reflections/]] — reflective practice
- [[wiki/experiments/00-index|experiments/]] — experimental records

## 10. Platforms
- [[wiki/android-core/00-index|android-core/]] — Android platform
- [[wiki/mobile-platform/00-index|mobile-platform/]] — mobile concepts

## 11. Engineering & QA
- [[wiki/testing/00-index|testing/]] — test frameworks, patterns, QA

## 12. Memory & Synthesis (OKF types)
- [[wiki/syntheses/00-index|syntheses/]] — distilled cross-session conclusions
- [[wiki/compositions/00-index|compositions/]] — instruction-set synthesis pages
- [[wiki/decisions/00-index|decisions/]] — recorded decisions
- [[wiki/pulses/00-index|pulses/]] — telemetry snapshots
- [[wiki/projects/00-index|projects/]] — project records
- [[wiki/plans/00-index|plans/]] — plans and roadmaps
- [[wiki/sources/00-index|sources/]] — source notes

## 13. Communities & Ops
- [[wiki/communities/00-index|communities/]] — git workflows & collaboration practices
- [[wiki/ops/00-index|ops/]] — mykb operational docs, prompts, reports
- [[wiki/daily/00-index|daily/]] — daily session logs

## Where does X live?

| If you want... | Look in... |
|----------------|------------|
| Auth / login / security fixes | `security-auth/` then `security/`, `identity/` |
| Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS, Angular, SPA) | `frontend/` → `frontend-frameworks/`, `js-ts-ecosystem/`, `web-platforms/` |
| Backend APIs, REST, HTTP, status codes | `api-services/`, `api-protocols/` |
| Cloud, AWS/Azure/GCP, networking | `cloud-infra/`, `infrastructure/` |
| CI/CD, deployment, SRE, observability | `devops-infra/` |
| Databases, caching, storage | `data-storage/` |
| Shell scripting, OS internals | `os-shell/`, `shell-environment/` |
| LLMs, agents, prompts, ML models | `ai-ml/`, `llm-agents/`, `agent-systems/`, `prompt-engineering/`, `ml-frameworks/` |
| Learning, memory, metacognition | `meta-learning/`, `memory/`, `episodes/`, `questions/` |
| Tests & QA | `testing/` |
| Distilled lessons / conclusions | `syntheses/` |
| Records (decisions, pulses, projects, sources) | `decisions/`, `pulses/`, `projects/`, `sources/`, `plans/` |
| Old / removed content | `raw/archive/` (junk-entities, audits, session-artifacts) |
